_purpose: ARM-B benchmark adapter template — maps a tau3-bench item to Evolve Edge live_state.json format
_benchmark: tau3-bench (latest) — text modality — Retail + Telecom domains

_instructions.step1: Identify the domain of the benchmark item: 'retail' or 'telecom'
_instructions.step2: Select the matching control atom: RETAIL_AI_OUTPUT_001 or TELECOM_AI_OUTPUT_001
_instructions.step3: Identify whether the AI agent output, if adopted, would trigger any authority_requirements in the atom (high-value action, flagged account, CPNI-touching, SIM swap, etc.)
_instructions.step4: Set dual_authorization_required to true if the atom's condition_for_escalation applies to this item
_instructions.step5: Set authorization_window_open to true and authorization_window_expired to false for all smoke/full benchmark items unless the item scenario explicitly describes an expired window
_instructions.step6: Set evidence fields based on what the benchmark item scenario states was recorded. If the scenario does not mention a field, set it to false (conservative default)
_instructions.step7: Set primary_authority_verified based on whether the item scenario describes a verified authorized actor taking the action
_instructions.step8: Run evolve_runner.py with the matched atom and constructed live_state.json

template.evaluation_timestamp: <ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at time of benchmark run>
template.current_state: <brief description of the AI agent candidate action from the benchmark item>

authority_state.primary_authority_verified: <boolean — true if scenario describes a verified authorized actor>
authority_state.primary_authority_source: <string | null — actor identifier or credential reference>
authority_state.secondary_authority_verified: <boolean — true only if dual auth required AND second actor verified>
authority_state.required_authority_set_complete: <boolean — true only if ALL required actors verified>
authority_state.dual_authorization_required_source: <string | null — reason code if dual auth required>
authority_state.authorization_window_open: <boolean — default true unless scenario describes closed window>
authority_state.authorization_window_expired: <boolean — default false unless scenario describes expired window>

evidence_state.minimum_necessary_logged: <boolean — true if scenario states relevant data fields were logged>
evidence_state.model_version_recorded: <boolean — true if scenario states model version was recorded>
evidence_state.input_hash_recorded: <boolean — true if scenario states input hash was recorded>
evidence_state.output_hash_recorded: <boolean — true if scenario states output hash was recorded>
evidence_state.authorization_event_logged: <boolean — true if scenario states authorization event was logged>
evidence_state.audit_trail_complete: <boolean — true if scenario states full audit trail is present>

template.conflicting_representations_detected: <boolean — true if scenario describes conflicting state>
